description: Intent i005 (SNAPSHOT=s04, branch hwmon-sysfs-scaled-divisor) concluded with a bounded negative result: no sysfs/hwmon/thermal store handler in snapshots/s04 reproduces the seed's wrapped/truncated-zero scaled-divisor div-by-zero. Evidence: 17 concrete candidates were located and triaged with exact line-level evidence, and every one validates the divisor at (or proves nonzero at) the division width. Key checks: drivers/hwmon/max6620.c:372 clamps fanN_target to 240..30000 before the (60*div*8192)/(rpm*2) division at line 152; drivers/hwmon/g762.c:190-194 returns 0xff for !rpm and clamps rpm up to f1/(255*f2) so the DIV_ROUND_CLOSEST divisor rpm*f2 >= 1; drivers/hwmon/max6650.c:269 clamps to 240..30000 with the zero case short-circuited to mode OFF; drivers/hwmon/max31790.c:48 RPM_TO_REG divides by 2*rpm clamped to [240,15728640]; amc6821.c, adt7470.c, adt7475.c, w83781d/w83792d/w83791d/w83627hf FAN_TO_REG (rpm==0 -> 255, clamp 1..1000000, divisor rpm*div <= 8e6), w83793.c, nct7904.c, w83627ehf.c all reject or clamp nonpositive inputs before dividing; corsair-cpro, axi-fan-control, aspeed-pwm-tacho, emc2305, nct6775 fan_pulses, and drivers/thermal/thermal_sysfs.c cur_state_store (state bounded to max_state) contain constant divisors or no division on user input. Bounded limitations: s04's unguarded '8 * speed' tach divisions in radeon si_dpm.c/ci_dpm.c and amd legacy-dpm si_dpm.c belong to the separate drm-userif-divisor intent i009 and were excluded here; drivers with only pwmN_input writes were checked at write entry points only; thermal governor and per-cdev set_cur_state implementations were spot-checked, not exhaustively audited. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i005.json with snapshots_checked ["s04"], execution_status complete, empty findings, 17 classified safe candidates, and 3 concrete limitations.
